text: This motion requests City Council approve the naming of a new park located at 144 Stephenson Ave. in honour of Gene Domagala, a longtime Beaches–East York resident whose extraordinary record of community service, volunteerism, and local leadership has had a lasting impact on the city. Gene Domagala is widely respected and cherished throughout the Beaches–East York community. Over the years, Mr. Domagala’s contributions have been well documented through countless stories shared by residents, community publications and local media. For decades, he has dedicated his time and energy to various community initiatives. His commitment to helping others has earned him a reputation as the unofficial “Mayor of the Beach,” a testimony to the admiration and respect he has earned from residents across generations. City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. Notwithstanding the provisions of the City of Toronto Property Naming Policy, City Council approve the naming of a new park located at 144 Stephenson Avenue to Gene Domagala Park.
